==English==

===Etymology===
Morphologically {{suffix|en|fall|en<id:past participle>}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɔːlən/|a=UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈfaːlən/|a=Northumbrian}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɔlən/|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɑlən/|a=cot-caught}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-fallen.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɔːlən|ɑlən|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{head|en|verb form}}

# {{inflection of|en|fall||past|part}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|-,more|sup=most,est<l:uncommon>}}

# Having dropped by the force of gravity.
#: '''''fallen''' raindrops''
# Killed, especially in battle.
#: ''a ceremony to honor '''fallen''' soldiers''
#: ''the disposal of '''fallen''' livestock''
#* {{quote-av
|en
|date=16 April 1945
|author=w:Harry S. Truman
|title=MP72-20 President Roosevelt’s Funeral and Procession; Truman – New President of U.S.
|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kil5e8GEEpU
|publisher=w:Harry S. Truman Presidential Library and Museum
|id=National Archives Identifier: [https://catalog.archives.gov/id/595162 595162]
|time=10:41
|text=We will face the problems of peace with the same courage that we have faced and mastered the problems of war. In the memory of those that have made the supreme sacrifice, in the memory of our '''fallen''' president, we shall not fail.}}
# Having lost one's [[chastity]].
#: ''a '''fallen''' woman''
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1991|author=Kelly Walsh|title=Nightshades and Orchids|isbn=9780373704750
|passage="You make yourself out to be the '''fallenest''' of '''fallen''' women." Tilting her head toward Sharon, Debbie grinned. "Let's face it. There can't be winners without losers, and I'm a loser. But look at it this way. I make it possible for some other woman{{...}}}}
# Having collapsed.
#: ''a '''fallen''' building''
# Having lost [[prestige]], (Christian) [[grace]], etc.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1913|author=John Bigelow|title=Retrospections of an Active Life: 1867-1871|page=397
|passage=That '''fallenest''' of our '''fallen''' race has left town — said to be near Fontainebleau by some, in Italy by others. More consequent with himself than usual, he is fulfilling, in the only possible way left open to him, his promise {{...}}}}

====Antonyms====
